name: hip and knee flexion squatting stretch
description: A deep squat hold that opens the hips and loosens the knees and ankles.
instructions: Stand with your feet a little wider than your shoulders and toes turned slightly out.
Sink down into a deep squat and press your elbows against your inner knees to open the hips.
Keep your heels on the floor and your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
